title: TexasAM vs UNT: tuition, size, accreditation
summary: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center (TexasAM) versus University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT). Also searched as UNT vs TexasAM. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: The University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) and the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center (TexasAM) are both public institutions located in Texas, with UNT situated in Fort Worth and TexasAM in Dallas. UNT has an undergraduate enrollment of 41 students, whereas TexasAM does not report undergraduate enrollment figures. Neither institution provides specific in-state tuition data. These differences highlight their distinct profiles within the public health education landscape of Texas.

sections.heading: Learning model and campus
paragraphs: The University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) and the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center (TexasAM) employ distinct learning models reflective of their specialized missions. UNT, located in Fort Worth, has a small undergraduate enrollment of 41 students, indicating a focus on graduate and professional health education. Both campuses are situated in major Texas cities, supporting their engagement with diverse urban healthcare communities.

sections.heading: Accreditation
paragraphs: The University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT) and the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center (TexasAM) are both accredited public institutions in Texas. UNT is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC) to award degrees at various levels. TexasAM also holds accreditation from SACSCOC, ensuring compliance with regional standards for higher education institutions. Both universities maintain program-specific accreditations relevant to their health science and medical education offerings, supporting their missions to provide quality education and training in healthcare fields.
